about_the_game:
As a heartfelt thank you to our dedicated community, we present the Supporter’s Pack: Decorations. This DLC is crafted for those who wish to journey the extra mile and support the ongoing development of Magisterium: Fantasy Craft. In return, we offer a trove of exquisite decorative items to personalize your home and garden, adding a new layer of beauty and storytelling to your world. Your support helps us create, and for that, we are immensely grateful.

Please note: All items are purely cosmetic and designed to enrich your visual experience without impacting gameplay mechanics.

After purchasing the DLC, a new vendor named Gustav will appear in the village market. Visit him to buy all DLC items. Some are sold as craftable blueprints, while others are ready-to-use items.

 

About this content:

This pack unlocks a vast collection of furniture and decorations to adorn your interior spaces and landscape your outdoor areas it includes 72 items.

·       An elegant collection of 11 unique carpets to ornate your floors and add warmth to any room:

1)     Short Narrow Rug

2)     Long Narrow Rug

3)     Green Square Carpet

4)     Red Square Carpet

5)     Cherry Square Carpet

6)     Dark Square Carpet

7)     Red Rectangular Carpet

8)     Simple Rectangular Carpet

9)     Mysterious Rectangular Carpet

10)  Tiny Celestial Carpet

11)  Alchemist’s Carpet Alchemical

Craft carpets at the tailor’s bench.

·       A versatile assortment of 2 path types and 5 complementary borders to define your garden walkways and outdoor spaces:

1)     Rough Stone Path

2)     Smooth Brick Path

3)     Wooden Border

4)     Rough Stone Border

5)     Smooth Brick Border

6)     Rough Stone Pillar Border

7)     Smooth Brick Pillar Border

To craft paths use constructor’s bench.

 

·       A distinguished collection of 5 Gothic-style chairs, ranging from humble seating to grand, regal thrones:

1)      Gothic Side Chair

2)      Regal Gothic Armchair

3)      Cloister Side Chair 

4)      Alchemist's Crescent Seat

5)      Magistrate's Seat

 

·       A splendid array of 3 majestic beds fit for royalty, promising a sublime and sweet slumber:

1)      Regal Gothic Bed

2)      Gothic Lattice Bed

3)      Crowned Gothic Bed

 

·       A Gothic Wall Shelf - а versatile shelving unit to display your books, pots, or candlesticks.

 

·       Complementary pieces to complete your Gothic abode:

1)      Gothic Refectory Table

2)      Ornate Gothic Chest

3)      Arcanum's Small Cabinet

4)      Gothic Bedside Table

Create chairs, beds and other pieces of furniture at the carpenter’s workbench.

 

·       An atmospheric set of 4 illuminations, including 2 intimate table candlesticks and 2 imposing floor stands to set the mood:

1)      Iron Candlestick

2)      Copper Candlestick

3)      Floor Candlestand

4)      Elegant Floor Candlestand

Forge candlesticks at the blacksmith’s bench.

 

·       A vibrant assortment of 4 small flower pots and 10 large pots featuring lush blooms and trees to bring life to your interior and exterior design:

1)      Small Daisy Pot

2)      Small Gerbera Pot

3)      Small Buttercup Pot

4)      Small Wild Rose Pot

5)      Large Sunflower Pot 

6)      Large Pink Flower Pot

7)      Large White Flower Pot

8)      Large Simple Tree Pot

9)      Large Green Tree Pot

10)   Large Plant Pot

11)   Large Maple Pot

12)   Large Lemon Tree Pot

13)   Large Blue Flower Pot 

14)   Large Yellow Flower Pot

 

·       A sophisticated collection of scholarly volumes to decorate your rooms and embrace the aura of a true academic:

1)      Leather-Bound Tome

2)      Stack of Scholarly Volumes

3)      Horizontal Research Library

 

·       A captivating gallery of 11 framed artworks, each telling a story of Lovelydale village and its enigmatic surroundings:

1)     Portrait of Emperor Mekhrahn’s Statue

2)     Wooden House Painting

3)     Gothic Gazebo Painting

4)     Wavy Bridge Painting

5)     Stone Effigies Painting

6)     Painting of the Fountain

7)     Painting of the Stone Monolith

8)     Painting of the Waterfall

9)     Painting of a horse

10)  Lovelydale Feast Hall

11)  Painting of the Withered Tree

Purchase pre-made flower pots, books and paintings to add charm to your house– no crafting required.

 

·       A charming selection of fences and walls to beautifully enclose and enhance your yard:

1)      Small Crossbeam Fence

2)      Crossbeam Wicket

3)      Long Crossbeam Fence

4)      Crossbeam Gate

5)      High Stone Wall

6)      Tall Stone Pylon

7)      Low Stone Wall

8)      Small Stone Pylon

 

·       Small Stone Fountain – а centerpiece fountain to grace your garden, giving it an air of aristocratic elegance.

Wooden Fences are crafted at the carpenter’s bench, while stone fences and a fountain are crafted at the constructor’s workbench.

 

We truly hope you enjoy this pack and the new creative possibilities it brings to your world. We would love to see your creations! Share screenshots of your decorated homes and gardens with our community on Discord and Steam.

The Supporter's Decorations pack includes 72 cosmetic items to customize your home and garden: furniture, carpets, garden paths, fences, flower pots and paintings. Perfect for players who want to add a touch of visual storytelling to their world.
